credits.title: Dear Ajayi
credits.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

credits.title: What No One Knows
credits.overview: Two friends enter into an agreement they intend to keep secret, but their lives start to implode, as the breadth of the decision unravels before them.

credits.title: Ogeere
credits.overview: A learned young man of Ayedun loved and respected by everyone and seen as a saint, falls in love with a special woman. And he swears an oath with the land to never leave her for another woman.

credits.title: Unfinished Business
credits.overview: A young Lagosian squatting with her friend, finds herself in an awkward situation when her friends boyfriend makes a move on her, forcing her friend to evict her to save her relationship, this eviction lands her in the arms of what she thinks is her prince charming.

credits.title: Ajuwaya
credits.overview: AJUWAYA – THE HAUNTED VILLAGE is a story of what happens when 6 corp members get posted to a remote village in Osun state and awaken an age long evil. - my9jatv.com

credits.title: Ohun Oko Somida
credits.overview: This emotional movie is about a love story of over 20 years that went sour within a short period of time when her husband met his mistress.

credits.title: Back to Africa
credits.overview: Sade, an American, embarks on a journey to Africa in search of her long lost father who abandoned her in New York as a child.

credits.title: Owo-Blow: The Genesis
credits.overview: Mr. Owolabi is a father of four whose quest to create a just society unwittingly earns him a ten year jail term. His incarceration wreaks havoc on his family, who are forced to do whatever it takes to survive.
